about.title: A community project
about.intro: Feudal League was born to give players at low and mid rating a place to compete against people of their own level. The code is open: anyone can read it, suggest changes and help improve it.

how.title: How it works under the hood

c1.title: Data from the game itself
c1.text: Rating and history come from the AoE2 server. Nothing is typed by hand.

c2.title: No screenshots, no reports
c2.text: A match between members is found in the history and turns into points by itself.

c3.title: Division by peak
c3.text: You enter by the highest rating you ever had, not the current one. That keeps smurfs out.

code.title: Code
code.text: Next.js, Postgres, a Node worker and a Python analyzer. Before a big change, open an issue to talk it over.

translate.title: Translations
translate.text: All text lives in messages/pt.json and en.json, with the same keys. Another language is a new file.

issues.title: Found a problem
issues.text: A match that did not count, a nickname that does not show up, a wrong civ or map name. Tell us, with the page link.

guide.title: How to contribute
guide.text: Local setup, checks before the pull request and project conventions.

support.title: Support the project
support.heading: Keeping the portal online costs money.
support.text: Leagues, tournaments and profiles are open to everyone. If you want to help with the costs, donating is optional and any amount works.
support.soon: The donation link is coming soon.
support.badge: Donors get the Supporter badge on their profile, if they want to show it.
support.seeSupporters: See who has already helped the project →

legal.title: License and notices
legal.art: That is why the portal uses no logo, icon or art from the game, and the name does not present itself as official.
legal.license: The code is free, under the <agpl>GNU AGPL v3</agpl>: you can use, study and modify it, as long as you publish your changes too.
legal.api: Rating and match data come from the game's own server, through an undocumented interface that may change without notice.
